channel.title: YWAM San Francisco blog
channel.description: Stories from life on Ellis Street in the Tenderloin.

item.title: Why a Discipleship Training School Can Change Your Life?
item.description: More than a school, DTS is a journey of knowing God, growing in faith, serving others, and discovering your purpose in God's mission.

item.title: Step into your calling
item.description: Be trained. Be transformed. Be sent. DTS starting January 18 is your chance to live out your faith and impact the world around you.

item.title: Church on the Street
item.description: Our Mission Adventure Program is designed for those who want to step out of the ordinary and into a life that truly makes a difference

item.title: Keeping the Lights On – 'After Hours' in the Ellis Room
item.description: When it rains in the Tenderloin, the Ellis Room barely closes. The lights stay on and the mission carries late into the night. People with nowhere else to go come in from the cold, shaking off the rain and warming their hands around steamin

item.title: Where Faith meets the Marketplace
item.description: The SOTB exists to train faith-driven leaders to bring transformation to the marketplace, where profit and purpose meet.

item.title: Church That Shows Up
item.description: Every Sunday morning, church shows up right outside our community center. What begins with hot chocolate and cookies often turns into worship, a simple message, and moments of prayer that touch hearts. Pop-Up Church is a reminder that God meets people right where they are—sometimes on a sidewalk, holding a warm cup, discovering unexpected hope.

item.title: Feeding Our City with Hope
item.description: Every week in San Francisco, more than 300 people line up not just for groceries, but for hope. At the YWAM San Francisco Food Pantry, neighbors are met with fresh food, warm smiles, and the assurance that they are seen and valued. Through our partnership with the SF-Marin Food Bank and the faithful service of volunteers, a simple grocery distribution becomes a powerful expression of love in action.

item.title: Hot Chocolate, A Simple Ministry Making a Real Impact in San Francisco
item.description: On the streets of San Francisco, something simple is making a real impact. At YWAM San Francisco, our Hot Chocolate Ministry uses a warm drink to build connection, restore dignity, and share the love of Jesus—one conversation at a time.

item.title: The Harvest is plentiful
item.description: DTS is not just a program; it is a season of transformation where Jesus shapes your heart, deepens your identity, strengthens your faith, and equips you to go wherever He leads. It is a space where ordinary believers are trained to live extraordinary lives of courage, obedience, and love.

item.title: Discover God’s Heart
item.description: Discover God’s Heart in the City. The Journey of a Discipleship Training School (DTS) in San Francisco

item.title: God's heart in the Marketplace
item.description: Discover how to use your entrepreneurial gifts to advance the Kingdom of God in every sphere of society.

item.title: Urban DTS
item.description: The next DTS (Discipleship Training School) in San Francisco will equip you to embrace urban ministry. This program is crafted to be a transformative journey. Where faith becomes practical. Relationships are deepened, and God's passion for the nations becomes your own.

item.title: The Great Commission
item.description: Business can be more than profit. It can bring hope, justice, and lasting transformation. This school will help you align your business calling with God’s mission. Let us complete the Great Commandment of Jesus!

item.title: The next DTS
item.description: DTS is more than just a school; it's a call to transformation. If you're ready to step out in faith, grow closer to God, and engage in His mission, this DTS is for you. Apply today and embrace the urban ministry.

item.title: School of Transformational Business (SOTB)
item.description: Transforming communities and nations through business. Join us as we pioneer businesses that bring hope, dignity, and transformation to communities and nations!

item.title: A Safe Haven in the Heart of the Tenderloin. Life in the Ellis Room!
item.description: It’s also a place where God’s love is expressed in simple ways every day. A shared laugh over a puzzle. A word of encouragement during a game of chess. A prayer is offered quietly in the corner for someone who asks.

item.title: A Life Changing journey for the next generation!
item.description: San Francisco is one of the most diverse, challenging, and spiritually hungry cities in the world. It's a place where faith meets reality.

item.title: Is God Calling You Deeper?
item.description: The Discipleship Training School at YWAM San Francisco offers a unique opportunity for spiritual growth and self-discovery.

item.title: Start up a Business
item.description: The School of Transformational Business (SOTB) teaches people to start and run a godly, profitable business. We aim to bring God’s kingdom to earth through every business.

item.title: Great Commission
item.description: The Great Commission is a call for every believer. We, Business with a Mission, organize, train, and equip people to network and take the Gospel to the less-reached places through business.

item.title: Business With A Mission
item.description: Business With A Mission is a great opportunity to reach out to this generation. The job we do, the people we meet, and our quality of life are influenced by business.

item.title: Love Your Neighbor(hood): Tech In The Tenderloin
item.description: Let’s all be bridge-builders where we are. Whether you’re here in San Francisco, or somewhere else. As Jesus was Immanuel, God with us, let us who know him be with those in our communities and cities.

item.title: Love Your Neighbor(hood): The Youth of the Tenderloin
item.description: These kids know and embrace that their neighborhood is not always the cleanest, rough around edges or even unsafe at times; and yet they talk about how they know it won’t be like that forever, because they are going to grow up and make a difference in it. And that is why it’s an honor to walk side by side with these visionaries.

item.title: Love Your Neighbor(hood): History of the Tenderloin
item.description: These days the Tenderloin is still a welcoming beacon for all. YWAM is able through God’s provision to provide a place for those in need, giving a place to drop-in, showers, restrooms, food pantry. A place where Jesus is lifted up and shared into the community.

item.title: Reflections on Easter during this crisis
item.description: The resurrection of Jesus is my favorite message–story–event ever. Resurrection Day is a day for me that marks the beginning of my year, it reminds me why I breathe, why I do what I do and why I am who I am. It is on this day that I remember that it is Christ who gives me great hope…
